create_ElectraConfig: create an ElectraConfig instance with default ELECTRA model configuration parameters
build_ElectraConfig_custom: build an ElectraConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads values
review_ElectraConfig_attributes: review the ElectraConfig class attributes including vocab_size, embedding_size, and hidden_act defaults
summarize_ElectraConfig_summary_params: summarize the ElectraConfig summary_type, summary_use_proj, summary_activation, and summary_last_dropout parameters
test_ElectraConfig_inheritance: test that ElectraConfig inherits from PreTrainedConfig and exposes model_type as electra
